title: Probability of Retaining a Scaled Sign
statement: Let $0\le\delta\le1$ and let $b\in\{-1,1\}$. Under the sign-valued noise distribution whose mean is $(1-\delta)b$, the probability of obtaining $b$ is $1-\delta/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $b$ is an integer unit, hence a sign
